findings.text: None of the four echoes a rival's look: the paint-by-number rows are all bright flowers, pixel hearts, pumpkins and easels, and no candidate uses a flower, heart grid or easel.

[B]: a lone crescent on dark navy sits very close to the sleep row (Sleep Sounds - R..., Sleep: Sounds & ..., White Noise Deep...); the numeral 3 is the only thing setting it apart, and it shrinks to a speck at the smallest tinted size. Not a franchise copy, but the look is the sleep category's, not ours.
[A]: crescent and stars over purple dunes recalls the sleep icons (Sleep Sounds - R..., BetterSleep) more than painting, and its 4 is tiny; generic night imagery rather than borrowed from anyone.
[C]: a full moon with blotchy maria on dark purple matches no rival in the rows shown; BetterSleep's moon is a white glow on a green hill, clearly different.

[D]: no rival name contains "Heart" with "Paint by", though heart icons are common among color-by-number rivals (Color by Number, Colors by Number, Sandbox); its icon uses dunes and a 6, not a heart, so no look-alike.

No name follows a famous order, house or council, and "Paint by Moonlight" / "Paint by Heart" appear nowhere in the rival names list. Avoid: drifting further toward the lone-crescent-on-navy sleep-app template, and any ® naming style like Happy Color® or ColorPlanet®.
